links.comparator_used: Initial TacroDose AI prompt before refinement (single initial prompt)
links.outcome: Protocol adherence, sentinel errors and reproducibility of tacrolimus dosing recommendations in 300 simulated scenarios
links.effect: Adherence 72.9% to 91.7%; sentinel errors 13.9% to 1.0%; reproducibility 77.3% to 86.7% (all p < 0.01)
links.tradeoff: Rounding discrepancies increased, though described as minor numerical differences without clinical relevance. Evaluated only in simulated scenarios.
links.quote: Prompt refinement substantially improved performance: TacroAI 2.0 achieved 91.7% adherence, reduced sentinel errors to 1.0%, and improved reproducibility from 77.3 to 86.7% (all p < 0.01).

design_hint: prompt guardrails with protocol constraints and structured output verification
